description: This file implements authentication and authorization utilities for a Flask-based web application, including JWT token creation/validation, user management, and access control decorators.

methods.name: _get_env
methods.description: Reads environment variables with optional default fallback.

methods.name: get_jwt_secret
methods.description: Retrieves the JWT secret from environment variables, defaulting to an insecure secret.

methods.name: get_jwt_ttl_seconds
methods.description: Returns the JWT token time-to-live in seconds, configurable via environment.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token for a user dictionary.

methods.name: decode_token
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token.

methods.name: _extract_bearer_token
methods.description: Extracts Bearer token from Authorization header.

methods.name: _public_user
methods.description: Returns a user dict with sensitive info removed.

methods.name: seed_admin_if_missing
methods.description: Ensures demo users have password hashes, creating default admin and user passwords if missing.

methods.name: register_user
methods.description: Registers a new user and returns public user info and JWT token.

methods.name: authenticate_user
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns public user info and JWT token.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user based on JWT token.

methods.name: admin_required
methods.description: Decorator enforcing admin privileges on endpoints.
